svg.aria-label: Article 23(1): the relief narrows to what Malta taxes
svg.text: Article 23(1): the relief narrows to what Malta taxes
The convention relieves the income in one state
Article 18 sends a private pension to the state of residence
The other state taxes it only on the amount remitted
Maltese law taxes a non-domiciled resident on what is brought in
The relief applies only to the part that other state taxes
So the part you do not remit is not sheltered by the treaty either
UK-Malta convention signed 12 May 1994, in force 27 March 1995.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 9 September 2026
